intent_en: To demonstrate the substantial reduction in fatality risk provided by professional negotiation services under Kidnapping & Ransom insurance.
previous_intent: To illustrate the effectiveness of Kidnapping & Ransom insurance in reducing the likelihood of death through professional negotiation, and to highlight the lack of awareness regarding this coverage among corporate travelers.
narration_support: reduces the chance of death from 9 % to just 2%
chart_support: Graphic titled 'KIDNAPPING & RANSOM INSURANCE' displaying a visual flow from the number 9 to the number 2, indicating a reduction.
